name: feature-list-4x5
summary: 4:5 PDP ad. Logo bar, 16:9 video window, deep panel with headline, badge pill, ruled section label, five chip+description rows, pill CTA with arrow.
notes: Retargeting keeps the bar and the 598px panel; the 16:9 window becomes 1178px tall at 9:16 and a 338px strip at 1:1. Row pitch is 54.25px — fractional, and not something anyone picks by eye. CTA arrow is drawn as a polygon; U+25B6 is tofu in most CJK faces.
